feeds.title: ClassicCars Journal
feeds.description: The ClassicCars.com Journal is a daily automotive news and entertainment source that caters to classic and collector vehicle enthusiasts. As a go-to platform for car enthusiasts, the blog provides up-to-date news, reviews, analysis, and opinion pieces on all aspects of classic and collector cars.

feeds.title: Classics World
feeds.description: With the modern world ever-changing with new technology, we bring you all the news relating to classic cars and how it affects our passion. Classics World is a website dedicated to bringing you the latest classic car news, reviews, buying advice, and auction reports.

feeds.title: ClassiCarNews.com
feeds.description: Your daily source for collector car news. Here you'll find articles written on the world's most important collector car events.

feeds.title: Take to the Road
feeds.description: Take to the Road was founded in January 2015 by motoring journalist Niall Julian. It is all about the passion for classic cars. It is a hub for the best classic car news, features, and reviews.

feeds.title: My Car Heaven » Classic Cars
feeds.description: MyCarHeaven is dedicated to showcasing, talking about, reviewing the most beautiful, cool, iconic and desirable cars and supercars. If you are reading this, you should either own or desire a beautiful car, due to beautiful looks, superb engineering, the prestige of ownership or another personal reason. MyCarHeaven is where you can find information about the cars and associated cool stuff that really matters. Subscribe to stay updated about Classic Car News.

feeds.title: All Collector Cars Blog
feeds.description: Created by world-class collector car consultants, All Collector Cars is a popular Car collector agency with over 40,000 classic car and truck auctions, and their classic car blog offers tips, guides, and insights into the world of classic car auctions.

feeds.title: Frank's Classic Car Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to my web page. Franks Classic Car Blog is a combination of repair tips, car-related facts, opinions, and some of my photographs thrown in for good measure. I have been messing with cars and cameras since I was around 14. That is when I got my first car and my first camera - a 1961 Triumph Spitfire and a 35mm Argus. So you might say I have had my share of hands-on experience with both hobbies.

feeds.title: Enjoy Classic Cars Blog
feeds.description: This website is for classic car enthusiasts who enjoy adventure, travel, conversation, and culture as much as their interest in cars about preparing our classics and ourselves for adventure and travel without the exclusivity of Marque worship and the overhead of a car club. My hope is that readers will be motivated to organize their own small groups of enthusiasts to drive their classics to interesting events or destinations and invite younger people along for the ride.

feeds.title: Cars UK » Classic Cars News
feeds.description: Classic Car news on Cars UK, with all the latest high profile news on traditional classic cars as well as more modern classics.

feeds.title: The Surgery Blog
feeds.description: The Surgery is New Zealand's premier Automotive and Classic Car Restoration studio. Their experience of over 30 years in the classic car restoration and repair industry is yours to be called on. Along with their team of craftsmen, they provide owners of classic and collectible cars with the restoration of a world-class standard. They have a wealth of experience and expertise in the business of specialist car restoration and repair and can be relied on to provide sound advice, options, and an excellent end result, in a professional and friendly manner.

feeds.title: MG ZT info mods and maintenance
feeds.description: Information, motoring news and reviews, modifications and maintaining, including repairs and servicing the MG ZT and Rover 75 which are now fast becoming future classic cars. It is a collection of articles I find around the Internet with a link back to the original source.

feeds.title: Vintage and Classic Car Blog
feeds.description: Covers all things classic and vintage, from racing to road signs.

feeds.title: My Car Quest
feeds.description: My Car Quest is about classic cars, race cars, other cars of interest and the people who made or drove those cars. Viewed from the perspective of the collector, the enthusiast and the lover of classic cars who believe that they are art on wheels.

feeds.title: Classic Cars Today Online
feeds.description: All the automotive news that's fit to remember. We're not a dealer - what we seek to do is explore the subject of classic vehicles from the 1950s through today. It is our belief that a car needn't be old to be respected and admired for graceful design, historical significance and collectibility.

feeds.title: Classic Industries
feeds.description: Classic Industries is the worldwide leader in automotive restoration parts & accessories with nearly four decades of experience. We carry nearly 200,000 parts for many iconic GM & Mopar vehicles. Explore our articles on classic cars, features, news on cars for sale and more!

feeds.title: Restoria Classics
feeds.description: Learn about what to look out for when buying your own classic car, vintage car insurance and helpful advice on maintaining your vehicle & much more. At Restoria Classics we pride ourselves in providing a reasonably priced professional service to restore your prized classic car to its original state and then maintain it for you to enjoy. We employ a skilled team of fabricators, painters, upholsterers mechanical and electrical engineers that have many years of experience in doing just this and who all share a passion for these wonderful cars.

feeds.title: Trade Classics
feeds.description: We launched Trade Classics back in 2011 as a free classic car classified site. We have since evolved into providing a passionate and personal service and started to auction cars in 2017; in a way that had never been done before. Know more about classic cars, auctions, features, news and more!

feeds.title: Total Cost Involved Blog
feeds.description: Stay informed with the latest news, trends and updates from Total Cost Involved classic car and truck blog. Total Cost Involved Engineering Inc. is a US Manufacturing Company that has produced complete chassis plus front and rear suspension for classic cars since 1974.

feeds.title: Dyler Classic Cars Blog
feeds.description: Explore our original content, car buying guides, market trends, and the best from the past: cars, brands and designers. Dyler website is an innovative classic, sports, and exotic cars' listing platform. The online marketplace was born from our passion for classic cars. Dyler officially launched in January 2017 and in more than 2 years, our database had more than 10 000 classified ads.

feeds.title: Classic Nation Blog
feeds.description: A user-submitted classic car website dedicated to all classic cars, hot rods, and muscle cars built before 1972. It is a home of the most popular classic car blog on the web. Classic Nation is a classic car enthusiasts website featuring photos, event calendar, classifieds, forums, and more! Submit links, stories, and photos of interesting classic car topics right here.

feeds.title: Jalopy
feeds.description: Covers classic car news, museum visits, auctions and the biggest shows. Jalopy Magazine is all about classic cars & motorcycles from around the world. We are fascinated by automotive history and share that with our readers along with our huge collection of photos in many galleries.

feeds.title: Sunday Times Driving » Classic Car
feeds.description: Driving.co.uk is your destination for daily motoring news, features, advice, reviews and video. Created by The Sunday Times, home of Jeremy Clarkson. Daily motoring news, features, reviews and advice from The Sunday Times.

feeds.title: Classic Car Connections Blog
feeds.description: Classic Car Connections' aim is to bring together car enthusiasts and businesses to enjoy our events and share knowledge of classic cars. Our blog posts describe the array of cars we have and the stories behind them

feeds.title: Classic Auto Advisors Blog
feeds.description: Classic car restoration guide and blog to teach the DIY owner about owning, and maintaining classic cars and trucks Classic Auto Advisors. This blog is our effort to help educate that average vintage car owner as well as a guide thru the classic car restoration process.

feeds.title: Midlife Classic Cars Blog
feeds.description: Join us as we interview vintage and classic car experts, get more information on the classics and more! Midlife Classic Cars is an automotive specialist book company based in Charlotte, North Carolina, USA. Opened in January 1990, we have over 4000 book titles and manuals in stock.

feeds.title: Petrolicious
feeds.description: AutoClassics is your single stop for news about classic cars. Everything from pre-war to muscle to Euro to modern classics - we cover them all on AutoClassics. Join us as we celebrate the best of what was in the automotive. AutoClassics is a new information base for collector cars of all ages, from turn-of-the-century pioneers to the latest supercars. It provides high-quality news, features and market analysis.

feeds.title: Petrolicious
feeds.description: Petrolicious creates quality, original videos and articles for classic car enthusiasts. We celebrate the inventions, the personalities, and the aesthetics that ignite our collective lust for great machines. We are fans and fanatics, collectors and racers. Petrolicious is a leading automotive lifestyle brand providing world-class short films and tasteful editorial around the world finest classic vehicles.

feeds.title: Old Cars
feeds.description: Old Cars covers the entire field of collectable automobiles from the classic touring cars and roadsters of the early 1900s to the popular muscle cars of the 1960s,70s, and 80s. Old Cars Weekly Magazine is your best resource for information on old car news, old car videos, antique car prices & collectable automobiles information. News from the world of classic cars, including old car auctions, car shows, vintage car museums and more.

feeds.title: Classic Car Africa
feeds.description: Classic Car Africa is a South Africa's classic car magazine giving updates of a classic car. Subscribe to get the latest news, articles and stories, straight to your inbox.

feeds.title: MyRod.com Blog
feeds.description: Family business in Dallas / Fort Worth, Texas specializing in high-quality classic cars! Not your typical big box store. We only deal with the keepers! No fake drama here, just real guys and real cars. We specialize in high-quality classic cars! You'll find videos, photos, 'how to' articles and cool road trip destinations all centered on classic cars!

feeds.title: MotorTrend » Classic Cars News
feeds.description: The official Motortrend magazine web site featuring the latest new cars, car reviews and news, concept cars and auto show coverage, awards, and much more. MotorTrend is your source for news and reviews on classic cars. Check out some of the coolest vintage cars and rare cars we have driven right here!

feeds.title: The Classic Motor Hub Blog
feeds.description: Based at the historic site of RAF Bibury in the heart of the Cotswolds, The Classic Motor Hub has something for everyone on our five-acre site dedicated to classic motoring; we're experts in sales, storage, and transport of classic cars, bikes, and modern high-performance machines.

feeds.title: Public Auto Auctions Blog
feeds.description: Public Auto Auctions, opened in 2001 in Austin, Texas with the vision of helping small charities benefit from car, truck, boat and RV donations. We are committed to finding the right buyer for each vehicle which results in higher resale prices and customer satisfaction. We have a long list of loyal auction clients including dealers, exporters, and individuals.

feeds.title: Classic Car Restoration Club Blog
feeds.description: Our goal at Classic Car Restoration Club is simple - To be the go-to resource for classic car enthusiasts who want high-quality, relevant car repair, maintenance and restoration videos, tips, and information. We want to inspire and educate classic car enthusiasts to restore their rides and get them on the road, so they can maximize their enjoyment of this great hobby.
